name: Terracotta Whistle Pendants – Handmade Jewellery

Terracotta whistles are one of India's oldest folk toys — and Pipihiri keeps that tradition alive with handmade clay whistles crafted by artisans who have been making them for generations. Each whistle is shaped by hand, kiln-fired, and hand-painted with bright, non-toxic colours that make them as beautiful to look at as they are fun to play with.

Our terracotta whistles are shaped like birds, animals, and traditional figures — each one produces a clear, melodic tone when blown. These handmade clay whistles are a favourite for gifting at children's parties, school events, and cultural festivals. They make wonderful return gifts, kanjak gifts, and Diwali mela souvenirs. Each one is light, packable, and affordable — easy to buy in sets and give to groups.

Beyond children, our terracotta whistles are also collected by folk art enthusiasts and Indian craft lovers as examples of living artisan tradition. Browse the full range below. Free shipping above ₹999 across India.
